## Orzar (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
CN Large monstrous humanoid (aquatic)  
**Init** -1; **Senses** blindsense 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 12, touch 8, flat-footed 14 (-1 Dex, +4 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 15 (2d10+4)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +2, **Will** +4 (+6 vs. fear effects); **Resist** cold 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., swim 50 ft.  
**Melee** +6 slam (1d8+5 bludgeoning plus grab, 20/x2)  
**Special Attacks** bloodsucking constriction (1 Con)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 9, **Con** 15, **Int** 4, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +7 (+9 grapple); **CMD** 16  
**Feats** Improved Grapple, [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
**Skills** Perception +5, Survival +5, Swim +18  
**Languages** Aquan  
**SQ** amphibious  


**Special Abilities**


**Bloodsucking Constriction (Ex)** While the Orzar maintains a grapple, it automatically inflicts 1 point of Constitution damage per round without the need to make a combat maneuver check to inflict damage. Each point of Constitution drained restores 1d3 HP to the orzar if the creature is wounded. This ability otherwise functions identically to the constrict universal monster ability.  

**Ferocious Grab (Ex)** Orzarii have no fear of grappling sea beasts even larger than themselves. The orzar can use their grab ability creatures of up to size Huge. If two or more Orzarii are engaged with the same creature, they may use their grab ability on creatures up to size Gargantuan.  

**Land Weaknesses (Ex)** Orzar are adapted to life underwater and are at a severe disadvantage on land. The creatures suffer a -4 penalty on attack rolls, combat maneuvers, skill checks and saving throws when outside the ocean.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** any ocean  
**Organization** usually hunts solitarily, found in tribal groups of 4d6 adults and twice as many juveniles  
**Treasure** incidental
